hhl_kernel_rel_err_doc: ||A_q y - b|| / ||b|| (dimensionless) of the quantum solution y to the system actually given to the circuit: A' (shifted) when deflate_k > 0, A otherwise; HHL: after scaling, before the deflation recombination, so independent of the classical share. SQLS writes the same column as linsys_residual / ||b|| on the original system.
